initial_plan.can_answer: partly: can compare reported persons injured per recorded crash, but cannot measure risk per trip or distance traveled
initial_plan.metric: reported persons injured per eligible crash record
initial_plan.population: police-reported NYC motor-vehicle crashes with a usable date and nonmissing reported injury count, grouped by clock-time period
initial_plan.filters: use complete calendar years only; night is 20:00-05:59, day is 06:00-19:59, missing or invalid times are unknown; exclude records with missing injury count
initial_plan.years: all complete calendar years present in the file, determined by the data check
initial_plan.grouping: calendar year and time period (night, day, unknown)

data_check_decisions.coverage: The file spans 2012-07-01 through 2026-06-11. Exclude 2012 and 2026 because their observed date extents are partial; use 2013-2025, whose date extents run Jan 1-Dec 31. No rows have a NULL crash_date.
data_check_decisions.clock_time: Among 2,132,218 dated crash rows in complete years, 0 have NULL, placeholder-string, or invalid crash_time. Keep all rows; 23,787 midnight times are retained as reported and classified as night, while disclosing that the data cannot confirm whether midnight is a default-coded time.
data_check_decisions.outcomes: Within the population, number_of_persons_injured is NULL in 18 rows. Exclude these from numerator and denominator because injury burden is unknown.
data_check_decisions.row_counts: Annual dated population rows range from 203,742 in 2013 to 85,546 in 2025; these are crash-record denominators, not exposure measures.
data_check_decisions.changes: Restrict to complete date-extent years, exclude rows with missing injury count, and retain midnight values as reported in the night group.

final_plan.can_answer: partly: answers the reported injury burden per recorded crash by time of day, but not the risk to a traveler per trip or distance traveled
final_plan.metric: mean reported persons injured per eligible crash record
final_plan.denominator: crash records in each year and time period with nonmissing number_of_persons_injured
final_plan.population: police-reported NYC motor-vehicle crashes with a nonmissing crash date in 2013-2025 and nonmissing injury count
final_plan.filters: exclude partial date-extent years 2012 and 2026 and records missing injury count; night is 20:00-05:59, day is 06:00-19:59; missing/invalid times are an unknown group (none observed); retain midnight as reported in night
final_plan.grouping: calendar year and time period (night, day, unknown)
final_plan.limitations: The file has only partial date extents in 2012 (July 1-Dec 31) and 2026 (Jan 1-June 11), so those years are excluded. Among 2,132,218 dated rows in 2013-2025, the injury count is NULL in 18 and those rows are excluded. No crash_time values are missing, placeholder, or invalid; 23,787 exact-midnight times are retained in night, although possible default coding cannot be verified. Dated annual crash rows range from 203,742 in 2013 to 85,546 in 2025; annual per-crash averages account for the number of recorded crashes in each group, but no trip/traffic/distance exposure denominator is available.
